title: Erdős Girth Conjecture
exact_target: For every fixed forbidden short-cycle length, can graphs have no such cycles while retaining the conjecturally optimal power-law number of edges?

sources.citation: Dániel Gerbner and Cory Palmer, Survey of Generalized Turán Problems—Counting Subgraphs, EJC Dynamic Survey 27 (2026), Conjecture 1.8.
